title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Between me and you, on Weds., I gave Al a heads up I was going to put those names out there and we talked and he mentioned that you are heading the COVID protocol and doing a really good job
I think it has the potential for a good story. For me: In-depth on an important topic. For you: Publicity to show that you can succeed in a leadership role in a big situation

I am conscious of the sensitivity of it, MLB protocol and all of that, and I will go through the proper channels in pitching it. I’m not looking for a basic feature story, but something more. If it doesn’t happen, it doesn’t happen - it’s probably out of our hands. But if you are interested in hearing my ideas about this, give me a call whenever you have a few minutes
Thanks, Anthony I appreciate the kind words. I would rather not at this point, Al is the one to speak for the organization.
For sure, thanks for getting back to me
